brief_rationale: No responsibility-chain errors. All six RCs met through comprehensive symptom screening, medication safety emphasis, infection status clarification using workspace evidence, record reconciliation, handoff planning, and family conflict resolution with teach-back. HO4 completed: doctor explicitly bounded residual risks (missing HBV DNA details, need for follow-up), maintained safe waiting instructions, and confirmed the goal was safe handoff not definitive diagnosis. HO3 completed: doctor discovered non-volunteered family conflict (forced isolation, fear of contagion, patient feeling rejected) and integrated this into a de-stigmatizing plan. HO1 and HO2 partially addressed but integrated into RC work. Closure is valid with explicit contingency criteria.
